problem.en: Fill in: "The match starts __ 4 p.m. __ Sunday."
Is "very" in "The tea is very hot" an adverb or a preposition?
problem.hi: "The tea is very hot" में "very" adverb है या preposition?

steps.en: It tells how hot → describes the adjective.
steps.hi: यह बताता है कितना गर्म → विशेषण के बारे में।

question.en: Fill in: "The cat jumped __ the box." (into/at)
Find the adverb: "He answered the question correctly."
question.hi: adverb ढूँढो: "He answered the question correctly."

intro.en: An adverb describes a verb, adjective or another adverb (She sings sweetly; very tall). A preposition shows the relation of a noun to other words: place (on, under), time (at, on, in) or direction (into, towards).
intro.hi: Adverb क्रिया, विशेषण या दूसरे adverb के बारे में बताता है (She sings sweetly; very tall)। Preposition संज्ञा का दूसरे शब्दों से संबंध दिखाता है: स्थान (on, under), समय (at, on, in) या दिशा (into, towards)।
